title: OpenAI Presence sells enterprise AI agents with engineers attached
slides: Can engineers turn an AI agent into a real teammate?
OpenAI Presence pairs its agents with dedicated engineers for deployment.
Most AI vendors sell software, not human support for customization.
Your team gets live code changes instead of static tools.
Test one agent with an engineer before scaling.
thread_text:
1. Engineers become teammates?

OpenAI pairs every AI agent with a dedicated engineer for deployment, not just selling software.

2. Most vendors sell only code

They give you a static tool and walk away. No human support for making it work.

3. Your team gets live changes

Instead of a frozen dashboard, you receive real-time code edits as the agent learns.

4. The twist: test one first

Deploy one agent with an engineer before scaling. Find failure before it spreads.

5. Action: simulate a live test

Take a prompt and run it with an engineer for one hour. Does the output improve? Try this week.

instagram.caption:
OpenAI now ships engineers alongside its AI agents—live human support for deployment, not just a dashboard.

Most vendors hand you a static tool and vanish. OpenAI keeps an engineer on your team to make real-time code edits as the agent adapts. 🧑‍💻

You test one agent with an engineer before scaling, catching failures early instead of spreading them across your workflow.

That changes what “buying AI” means: you’re hiring a teammate, not installing software.

What’s the one recurring task you’d run through with an engineer this week to see if it actually sticks?
